    return [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]

def transform(grid):
    """Build a 2x2 image of the grid's four quarter-turn orientations."""
    top = [list(row) for row in grid]
    top_right = rotate_cw(grid)
    bottom_left = rotate_cw(rotate_cw(rotate_cw(grid)))
    bottom_right = rotate_cw(rotate_cw(grid))
    return [top[r] + top_right[r] for r in range(len(grid))] + [bottom_left[r] + bottom_right[r] for r in range(len(grid))]
